split_policy: Disjoint code points; byte-identical raster pairs deduplicated. Components may recur across splits. Tangut is evaluation-only.
selection: CJK pool: sorted common U+4E00..U+9FFF excluding the 80 stress forms, shuffled with numpy default_rng(20261027), first 2048/256/256. Tangut: 140 fixed samples from the 0.002 proof (manual cases, dense forms, sparse forms, evenly spaced ideographs and components).
